## Change

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and approved requirement IDs.

## Validation

Link exact-head check results and immutable source/acceptance evidence. Distinguish planned, locally executed, CI-executed and deployed behavior. List any failed, unavailable or incomplete checks.

## Privacy and security

Describe authorization, data classification, consent, recipient/key custody and transaction impacts. Confirm no secret values or real personal/case fixtures are included. Record substantive source/security review and relevant tests; do not claim independent human review or certification that did not occur.

## Remaining work

List unresolved acceptance criteria, concrete external prerequisites and rollback/recovery considerations. Keep incomplete implementation draft.
